notes.title: v1.8 Patch - Fixing an issue in Chapter 7
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Traveler's Refrain, and for contacting us via the forum / discord about potential bugs you've uncovered!

Here's what's changed in this patch:
-Fixed a potential blocker where the vine snakes on the giant robot in chapter 7 wouldn't appear

notes.title: v1.7 Patch - Fixing a camera zooming bug
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Traveler's Refrain, and for contacting us via the forum / discord about potential bugs you've uncovered!

Here's what's changed in this patch:
-Fixed an issue that may happen in the robot village where the camera zooms out very far when entering the village elder's house
-Fixed an issue where you could recollect pieces of the broken mosaic in the third dungeon
-Various other small tweaks

notes.title: v1.6 Patch - Various bug fixes and enemy improvements
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Traveler's Refrain, and for contacting us via the forum / discord about potential bugs you've uncovered!

Here's what's changed in this patch:
-Added healing wells to the intro tutorial area (before getting to the first fountain so that you can heal after enemy encounters)
-Toned down the aggressiveness of the rock dasher enemy (Skultian)
-Fixed an issue where you could get knocked out of bounds in Chapter 7
-Various other small fixes

notes.title: v1.5 Patch - Allowing more backtracking opportunities for missed collectibles
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Traveler's Refrain, and for contacting us via the forum / discord about potential bugs you've uncovered!

Here's what's changed in this patch:
-Allowing more backtracking in the Robot City area -- can re-explore the third dungeon if you missed something at the end of the game, and can revisit the prison briefly if you missed an opportunity to do something there
-Fixed an issue where you could get the "robot stew" twice
-Minor adjustments and fixes

notes.title: v1.4 Patch - Fixing a possible progression blocker with spell tutorial events
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Traveler's Refrain, and for contacting us via the forum / discord about potential bugs you've uncovered!

Here's what's changed in this patch:
-Fixed a further issue that some players were facing with progressing in the song spell tutorial events, particularly the Nature's Impaler event and the Cha'kula event
-Minor bug and visual fixes

notes.title: v1.3 Patch - Fixing a possible progression blocker in Dungeon 2
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Traveler's Refrain, and for contacting us via the forum / discord about potential bugs you've uncovered!

Here's what's changed in this patch:
-Fixed a potential issue in Dungeon 2 where the "fire shooter" puzzle wasn't firing the event to continue through the next door
-Fixed other minor potential issues like colliders

notes.title: Day 1 Patch 2 - Addressing end of Chapter 1 progression issue
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Traveler's Refrain on launch day, and for contacting us via the forum / discord about potential bugs you've uncovered!

Here's what's changed in this patch:
-Fixed an issue at the end of Chapter 1 where you could sometimes talk to the robot in the tree, save / load, and get stuck from progressing behind a tree root
-Further fixes pertaining to the issue of sometimes not progressing after completing the Nature's Impaler song spell tutorial event

notes.title: Day 1 Patch - Addressing Issues with getting Nature's Impaler spell in Chapter 1
notes.content:
Hello everyone and thank you so much for playing Traveler's Refrain on launch! We've received great feedback and are monitoring the forums/discord for any issues so please report any if you see them.

Here are the notes from this patch:
- Fixed an issue sometimes preventing players from finishing the 2nd spell learning event, Nature's Impaler. This issue was able to be fixed by restarting the game fully. This issue should now be resolved without the need to restart.
- Fixed some minor issues around the Shadow Horror (large gear monster) persisting after a load and auto killing the player.

notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
We are excited to announce our partnership with indie.io to help bring Traveler's Refrain to more gamers!

As a small team of 5 devs, this project has been a massive (but incredibly rewarding) undertaking, and having a publisher help support us with getting the game out there has allowed us to focus on making Traveler's Refrain the best it can be.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44857191/d560823cd97a630b1d3cbbfbfdfa1e78b1057879.gif

For those of you who may not know, working with a game publishing platform like indie.io greatly helps indie developers focus on game development while they handle all the behind-the-scenes magic. From helping manage store pages to crafting marketing campaigns and even helping the game shine at both digital and live events, indie.io helps in all the aspects that indie developers often struggle with alone.

Clicking the Wishlist Button on our page goes a long way, and we'd love to chat with you about games in our DISCORD!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2679660/Travelers_Refrain/?utm_source=pubannouncement 

Check out the other amazing indie games being published by indie.io here!
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio

We can't wait to bring Traveler's Song-Casting adventure to you!
The Red Essence Games Team
